title: smime README example accesses nonexistent signer.certificate field
description: smime-tree/README.md line 103: 'signer.certificate.tbs_certificate().subject()' — SignerResult has no 'certificate' field; it only has 'verified: bool', 'subject: Option<String>', 'error: Option<String>'. Any user copying this example gets a compile error. Fix: change example to use 'signer.subject' instead.
